Name: LIMITED_DAY_ASSET_PARAM_ST
Description: Field assets that appear only in some phases of an expedition (day, night, final). Each row picks placed assets of the main field (m60) by model and instance number and says in which phases they are active.

Fields.Name: Asset ID
Fields.Description: Model number of the assets to control (AEG596_571 is 596571). 0: the row is ignored. Only assets placed on the main field (m60) are checked.

Fields.Name: Instance Number - Min
Fields.Description: Lowest instance number of the matching assets (Likely the number after the model in the placed asset's name). Retail 8900.

Fields.Name: Instance Number - Max
Fields.Description: Highest instance number of the matching assets (inclusive). Retail 8900.

Fields.Name: Active - Day
Fields.Description: Set: the assets are active during the normal (day) phase; clear: they are turned off then. Retail: clear.

Fields.Name: Active - Night
Fields.Description: Set: the assets are active while the night state is on (the same state that switches the weather to its night lighting); clear: they are turned off then. Retail: set on the one row (AEG596_571).

Fields.Name: Active - Final Battle
Fields.Description: Set: the assets are active after the play area's final warp (Likely the Nightlord battle); clear: they are turned off then. Retail: clear.

Fields.Name: Unknown
Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game. Retail 0.
